$comment: Read by shared-workflows' repo-settings-check, in settings.yml. docs/repository-settings.md is the checklist. requiredChecks are the checks that the ruleset on main must require by name. An exception names a setting and the reason that this repository differs, for example a private repository on the Free plan, which has no rulesets: { "setting": "main.pull-request", "reason": "…" }. An exception for a setting that is correct fails, so the list cannot rot.
